trigger: internal sequential counter trojan_cnt reaches 8'hAA (170 rising clock edges with en=1 after reset); on that specific clock edge the Trojan fires
observable_effect: count stops incrementing (freezes at its current value) on the triggering clock edge instead of incrementing by 1, while the clean module would increment normally; count remains frozen on every subsequent en=1 cycle as long as trojan_trig stays asserted (one cycle), then normal counting resumes — the net result is that exactly one increment is skipped/suppressed, demonstrating denial-of-service
